content.title: Who are the highest paid golfers at the 2026 Masters? What we know
content.text: April 6, 2026, 4:17 p.m. ETIt's no surprise that there's a lot of big money at the Augusta National. But whose wallet is the fattest?As of last year, the highest paid golfer in the world according to Forbes is 2023 Masters champion Jon Rahm who will be playing his 10th Masters this year. He made $92 million on the course and $10 million off-course.Meanwhile, the only golfer in the world to make billionaire status is five-time Masters champ Tiger Woods with Forbes reporting a real-time net worth of $1.5 billion. He's also the No. 1 PGA 'career money leader' meaning he's made the most throughout his career, almost $121 million. However, he will not be competing this year following a car crash and DUI arrest.Here are the top 10 career money leaders who are playing in this year's Masters:Rory McIlroyScottie SchefflerJustin RoseAdam ScottJustin ThomasVijay SinghJordan SpiethJason DayXander SchauffeleHideki MatsuyamaRory McIlroy net worthMcIllroy has won $110,196,641 on the course with $84 million in annual earnings, according to Forbes in 2025. This is his 18th Masters and he was last year's champion.Scottie Scheffler net worthScheffler has won $103,269,566, with $97 million in annual earnings according to Forbes in 2025. This is his seventh Masters and he was the 2022 and 2024 champion.Justin Rose net worthRose has won $75,951,420 and his net worth is estimated to be between $40 million and $60 million. This is his 21st Masters.Adam Scott net worthScott has won $71,576,075 and his net worth is estimated to be between $50 million and $60 million. This is his 25th Masters and he was the 2013 champion.Justin Thomas net worthThomas has won $71,383,912 and his net worth estimate ranges from $30 million to $60 million. This is his 11th Masters.Vijay Singh net worthSingh has won $71,312,738 and his net worth is reportedly about $75 million. This is his 32nd Masters and he was the 2000 champion.Jordan Spieth net worthSpieth has won $67,368,494 with annual earnings of $47.5 million according to Forbes in 2023. This is his 13th Masters and he was the 2015 champion.Jason Day net worthDay has won $66,071,136 with a reported net worth of $50 million. This is his 15th Masters.Xander Schauffele net worthSchauffele has won $65,272,747 with annual earnings of $48 million according to Forbes as of 2025. This is his 9th Masters.Hideki Matsuyama net worthMatsuyama has won $64,478,587 with annual earnings of $42 million according to Forbes as of 2025. This is his 15th Masters and he was the 2021 champion.Miguel Legoas is a Deep South Connect Team Reporter for USA Today. Find him on Instagram @miguelegoas and email atmlegoas@gannett.com.
